name: Avatar
description: Shows who someone is — their photo, or their initials when there is none.

name.description: Full name - used to generate initials

size.description: The control track: xs 24, sm 28, md 32, lg 40

imageProps.description: Additional props for the underlying img element (except src/alt/className/style)

fallback.description: Visual fallback rendered after initials and before the generic glyph

when: A row, comment, or card needs to say who
Several people belong to one thing — use Avatar.Group
whenNot: The picture is content, not identity (use Image)
A profile hero at display size (build the layout yourself)
guidelines: Pass name even when you pass src — it is the fallback and the label
Hold one size per context; xs (24) for rows, lg (40) at most
Avatar.Group max caps the stack and counts the rest
accessibility: alt describes the person, not the word "avatar"
Initials come from name, so screen readers get the whole name

examples.name: Default
examples.description: A photo, cropped to the circle and centred.
examples.code:
import { Avatar } from '@/components/Avatar';

<Avatar
  src="https://i.pravatar.cc/150?u=jane"
  alt="Jane Doe"
  name="Jane Doe"
/>

examples.name: With Initials
examples.description: No src, so the name collapses to initials.

examples.name: Sizes
examples.code:
import { Stack } from '@/components/Stack';

<Stack direction="row" gap="sm" align="center">
  <Avatar name="Jane Doe" size="xs" />
  <Avatar name="Jane Doe" size="sm" />
  <Avatar name="Jane Doe" size="md" />
  <Avatar name="Jane Doe" size="lg" />
</Stack>

examples.name: Group
examples.description: Overlapping stack with a count for whoever did not fit.
examples.code:
import { Avatar } from '@/components/Avatar';

<Avatar.Group max={3}>
  <Avatar name="Alice Johnson" />
  <Avatar name="Bob Smith" />
  <Avatar name="Carol Williams" />
  <Avatar name="David Brown" />
  <Avatar name="Eve Davis" />
</Avatar.Group>

relations.note: Use Image for content pictures that are not a person or entity
Pair with Badge to show presence or role beside a name

propsSummary: name: string - used for initials fallback
